item.description: The ASX is set to fall after its US counterparts also slightly dropped overnight, a day after Wall Street reached record highs. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alex Turner-Cohen

item.title: Rural hospital welcomes first student midwives in more than a decade
item.description: A central Queensland community fought for years for the return of the local birthing service. The next challenge is attracting and retaining the people who will keep it running. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Moon

item.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked protests dies
item.description: Maricarmen Abascal, the 87-year-old Spanish woman whose eviction sparked nationwide protests, has died. Ms Abascal had been hospitalised after she was evicted from the apartment she had lived in for seven decades. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: CA 'actively' looking at women's schedule as Aussie stars raise concerns
item.description: Frustrated players speak with Cricket Australia over the lack of elite women's matches at home in the peak of summer. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Live: Labor has 'real concerns' about ATO's credit card payments decision
item.description: Andrew Charlton says the government supports the tax office's decision to stop accepting credit card payments despite the housing minister saying Labor has "real concerns". Follow live. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joshua Boscaini

item.title: Small SA town's 'out of control' pigeon population
item.description: A remote community in South Australia's Murraylands has been battling to manage a large number of pigeons for about two decades. Residents say the issue is getting "out of control", both as a financial burden and a potential health hazard. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Amelia Walters and Oliver Brown

item.title: Former Catholic bishop sentenced for abusing indigenous men in Australia
item.description: The Catholic Church in Australia has been marred by abuse allegations in recent years. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: New armed police unit unveiled after Bondi terror attack
item.description: The new long-arms carrying unit is expected to begin public training on Sydney's streets after months of secretive work behind the scenes. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Aussies hit back at ex-players in build-up to first South Africa Test
item.description: Travis Head accuses former Australian players of levelling unfair criticism at the current Test squad, saying the game has changed significantly since they played. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Rahm to leave LIV Golf over 'unacceptable' terms
item.description: Jon Rahm will leave LIV Golf after deeming the terms for LIV 2.0 "unacceptable", his lawyer has told a bankruptcy court hearing. Publicado también por: ABC News Australia. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Landmark' child safety racial discrimination class actions to be discontinued
item.description: The Queensland lawsuits are being brought to an end in the Federal Court due to a lack of funding. First Nations families who signed up to the action years ago say the system has failed them once again. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lottie Twyford

item.title: Bathurst 1000: How to watch, race start time and weather forecast
item.description: Here is what you need to know about this weekend's Bathurst 1000, including when the race begins and how you can follow the action. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Doyle

item.title: Town questions $15b data centre set to use enough power for 1m homes
item.description: One Wagga Wagga resident says she feels "back-stabbed" by the development, while others say the town needs more industry. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Melinda Hayter

item.title: Mysterious Papua New Guinea rock reveals unexpected cooling as it descended deeper underground
item.description: The discovery of an unexpectedly hot rock beneath Earth's surface is challenging scientists' understanding of how heat is distributed deep inside the planet, with potential implications for how they understand earthquakes, volcanic activity and the movement of carbon through Earth. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Five cars set alight outside Melbourne homes in fourth night of firebombings
item.description: It brings the number of cars destroyed across the city this week to 11. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Was pre-COP a flop? Questions loom over the Australian government
item.description: The Pacific Islands climate summit held ahead of the official COP31 in Türkiye had its disappointments from the start, but the blame for falling short of climate targets rests with many. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Dziedzic

item.title: Victorians say 'lazy planning' leading to poor social housing outcomes
item.description: Residents near a proposed social housing project in Bendigo say the state government's fast-tracked planning process is allowing "lazy planning" to go ahead without sufficient scrutiny. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tyrone Dalton

item.title: Greens launch election platform with promise to slash grocery prices
item.description: The Greens will take on major supermarkets and address community safety with new policies inspired by New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia's wildfire crisis linked to colonial land-use change
item.description: Nature, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11097-z A 1,000-year lake-sediment record from southeastern Australia shows that colonial disruption of Indigenous cultural burning transformed open woodland into dense, flammable forest, priming the landscape for today’s climate-driven wildfires. Publicado también por: Nature. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Performance explores perinatal mental health and world of motherhood
item.description: Adelaide-based dancer Zoë Dunwoodie drew inspiration from her experience of motherhood, her grandmother's postpartum mental health and her mother's love of llamas to shape her latest performance. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Sophie Landau

item.title: Christa Pike woke 'angry and confused' after surviving botched execution
item.description: Convicted killer Christa Pike awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital this week, with her first words being: "Where am I?" Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Three years after October 7, much of Gaza is in ruins
item.description: Three years after the Hamas-led attacks in Israel on October 7, much of Gaza lies in ruins. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Former RBA board member says another rate hike 'plausible' this year
item.description: Another interest rate hike this year is "plausible", but not necessarily likely, according to economist Ian Harper, who only left the RBA Monetary Policy Board in August. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Michael Janda

item.title: New Zealand’s giant wētāpunga shows recovery after 11,000 insects released over 15 years
item.description: Wētāpunga, the largest giant wētā species in New Zealand, is rebounding after years of decline caused by habitat destruction and invasive predators. Thanks to dedicated conservation efforts, more than 11,000 wētāpunga have been bred and released into protected areas. With at least four generations now thriving in the wild, the program aims to sustain their growing populations and ensure their future survival. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Quiz: Think you know vinyl, CDs and cassettes? Prove it
item.description: Vinyl sales keep climbing, cassettes are creeping back and CDs are having a second life. But how much do you actually know about the formats that refuse to die? Fuente: ABC News Australia.
